name: RBI Information Security Audit Services
description: Comprehensive RBI IS Audit services covering cybersecurity, IT governance, and regulatory compliance for banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a regulatory audit that assesses an institution's cybersecurity, IT governance, and risk management framework in alignment with RBI guidelines. The audit evaluates technical controls, policies, procedures, and operational practices to ensure financial institutions are secure and compliant.

mainEntity.name: Who is required to undergo the audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Banks, NBFCs, payment banks, small finance banks, and fintechs regulated by the RBI are required to undergo regular IS audits to ensure compliance with RBI's cybersecurity and IT governance requirements.

mainEntity.name: How often should the audit be conducted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically annually or as mandated by specific RBI circulars. Some institutions may require more frequent audits based on their risk profile, size, or regulatory observations.

mainEntity.name: Does the audit include technical testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, including vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and application security reviews. We conduct thorough technical assessments of core banking systems, mobile apps, APIs, and infrastructure.
Yes, with secure access to systems and documentation. We use secure remote assessment methodologies while maintaining audit rigor and ensuring no compromise on quality or coverage.

Yes, we help implement and verify all remediation actions. Our team provides guidance on implementing recommended controls and conducts follow-up assessments to ensure fixes are effective.

Weak access management, unpatched systems, insufficient monitoring, gaps in policies, inadequate incident response procedures, and incomplete vendor risk assessments are among the most common findings.

mainEntity.name: How long does the audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Duration depends on the size and complexity of the organization. Typically, audits range from 3-8 weeks depending on the number of systems, branches, and scope of assessment.

mainEntity.name: Does the audit improve customer trust?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Demonstrating compliance and security strengthens client confidence, builds stakeholder trust, and enhances your institution's reputation in the market.
Yes, vendor controls and integrations are assessed. We evaluate third-party risk management frameworks, vendor contracts, and security practices of critical service providers.

mainEntity.name: Can multiple branches or entities be audited together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, scalable frameworks allow multi-entity assessments. This is particularly useful for banks with multiple branches or banking groups with different entities.

We evaluate disaster recovery plans, backup strategies, and failover mechanisms. This includes reviewing documented procedures, testing frequency, recovery time objectives (RTO), and recovery point objectives (RPO).

mainEntity.name: Why choose ISECURION for RBI IS Audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our combination of regulatory expertise, technical skill, and practical recommendations ensures comprehensive, actionable, and reliable audit outcomes. We don't just help you comply - we help you operate securely and build resilience against cyber threats.

mainEntity.name: What RBI circulars are covered in the audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover all relevant RBI circulars including those on Cyber Security Framework, IT Governance, Outsourcing guidelines, Digital Payment Security Controls, and other applicable notifications based on your institution type.

mainEntity.name: Do you assess cloud banking infrastructure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we assess both on-premise and cloud-based banking infrastructure, including hybrid environments. Our audits cover cloud security configurations, data protection, access controls, and compliance with RBI's guidelines on cloud adoption.

Yes, mobile banking and payment applications are thoroughly assessed for security vulnerabilities, authentication mechanisms, data encryption, session management, and compliance with secure coding practices.
